posts.title: I’ve never been a big fan of showing off, but today I want to share a small achievement that means t
posts.caption:
I’ve never been a big fan of showing off, but today I want to share a small achievement that means the world to me.

My new car. ❤️

In 2024, I had absolutely no idea how I was going to make it. There were so many moments filled with uncertainty, fear, and questions about whether everything I was working so hard for would ever pay off.

But God had different plans.

2025 gave me everything I had prayed for and so much more. Every blessing, every opportunity, every milestone has reminded me that His timing is always perfect.

Looking back at my journey feels unreal. From doubting myself to achieving things I once only dreamed about, this car isn’t just a purchase it’s a symbol of faith, resilience, and never giving up even when life feels uncertain.

Forever grateful for how far I’ve come, and even more excited for where I’m headed. Here’s to dreaming bigger, working harder, and trusting God’s plan. 🤍🚘 ab mummy ne bola hai toh leni Padegi hi😭🫂

27. 🤍

Today was supposed to look very different. I was supposed to be celebrating my birthday in Seychelles everything was booked. Last year, I promised myself that I’d travel somewhere new every birthday, and this year I actually got the opportunity.

But sometimes, life (and maybe God) has different plans.

At the last minute, I was left with an unexpected emptiness. I can’t help but laugh thinking about how much fun celebrating 27 in Seychelles would’ve been. Haha... maybe another time.

What I do have today is perspective. I can’t believe how much I’ve grown. I’ve become calmer, more mature, and somehow much quieter than I used to be. Not every birthday looks the way we imagined, but every year teaches us something we needed to learn.

Here’s to 27 to healing, new beginnings, unexpected journeys, and trusting that what’s meant for me will always find me.

Forever grateful. 🤍
